g.text: Every user-owned table carries owner_id, child tables
included (denormalized), so each one gets its own
owner-scoped EF Core query filter. Exceptions: the
Role, UserRole) and UserPreferences, keyed by user_id.
Secret's owner filter also returns instance rows
(owner_id null); only admins may write those.
Notes are not memory: they live in NoteIndexEntry
(search only). Important note content becomes a normal
Chunk written by the agent, source_ref = note path.
data : json «public key, sign count, name»
id : OwnerId-typed «PK, Identity shares the key type»
id : string «PK, SHA-256 hex of the cookie key»
value : bytes «serialized ticket incl. IdP tokens, Data Protection»
api_token_id : ApiTokenId «FK, null for web / task»
taint_sources : json <<mail | rss | notes | web | mcp:<id>, first tainting step>>
run_id : RunId «run that asked; no FK (retention)»
taint : json «[{kind, firstStep}] of that run»
reasons : json «[{code: rule | unresolved_target | taint | quiet_hours_override, detail}]»
language : de | en «language of the reason sentences»
expires_at : DateTimeOffset «~60 s conversation, 10 min approval queue»
status : pending | approved | rejected | dropped | expired | superseded
decided_by : keyword | judge | ui | push | system
id : ChunkId «PK, hash(owner_id + scope + project_id + type + normalized title)»
project_id : ProjectId «FK, set iff scope = project»
type : fact | preference | event | procedure | person | device
embedding : float[N] «cosine, N from the embedding model»
job : string «registered job of a system task»
origin_satellite_id : string «policy applies to all runs + children»
trigger_kind : now | at | cron | event | after
trigger_spec : string «time, cron, event filter json or task id»
trigger_payload : json «handed to the next run»
status : pending | running | waiting | done | failed | cancelled
name : string «unique (owner_id, name) where name is not null»
deliveries : json «[{channel, target, priority, followUp, when, expires, fallback, pendingSince, expiresAt}]»
deliveries_pending : bool «a delivery waits for its conditions»
status : starting | running | done | failed | cancelled
outcome : pending | delivered | coalesced | held | inboxed | expired | fallback
routing : json «requested channel, target, link, actions, ...»
consumed_at : DateTimeOffset «inbox item read by a task»
«unique (owner_id, name) where owner_id is not null»
drafts_folder : string «when no folder has special-use Drafts»
path : string «relative to the notes repository»
position : int «section order in the file»
file_hash : string «SHA-256 of the file when indexed»
